prompt_presets.concise: Summarize in 2-3 short punchy sentences for a voiceover.
prompt_presets.detailed: Provide a 5-sentence detailed summary covering key points.
prompt_presets.bullet: Give exactly 3 bullet points of the most important facts.
prompt_presets.social_hook: Write a viral social media post: shocking hook first, then 2 sentences. Max 150 words. No hashtags.
prompt_presets.script_video: Write a short video script: HOOK (1 sentence), BODY (3 sentences), CTA (1 sentence).
prompt_presets.news_anchor: Rewrite as a formal news anchor reading aloud. 4 sentences.
prompt_presets.casual_eli5: Explain like I'm 5, casual and friendly, 3-4 sentences.
prompt_presets.podcast_dialogue: Convert into a 2-person podcast dialogue with HOST: and GUEST: labels. 6 exchanges total.
